title: Sara's Week
text:
There are seven days in a week. Many people start the week on Monday. Sara goes to school from Monday to Friday. She likes Friday because the weekend is next.

Saturday and Sunday are the weekend. On Saturday, Sara plays football with her friends. On Sunday, she visits her grandmother and eats lunch with the family. Sunday is her favorite day.

questions.text: How many days are there in a week?
What does Sara do on Saturday?
options: She plays football with her friends

questions.text: On which day does Sara most likely NOT go to school?
What can you infer about Sara's family?
options: They spend time together on Sunday

vocabulary.definition: Saturday and Sunday, the two days at the end of the week
the thing or day that you like the most
the mother of your mother or father
a sport played with a ball and two teams, where players kick the ball

paragraph_translations: Hay siete días en una semana. Muchas personas empiezan la semana el lunes. Sara va a la escuela de lunes a viernes. Le gusta el viernes porque el fin de semana está cerca.
El sábado y el domingo son el fin de semana. El sábado, Sara juega al fútbol con sus amigos. El domingo, visita a su abuela y almuerza con la familia. El domingo es su día favorito.
